Write the number of the choice that applies best to the statement given below:
The gravitational pull on the surface of the Moon is approximately one-sixth of that on Earth.

Write the number of the choice that applies best to the statement given below:
Planting silver coins in fertile soil and watering them daily will eventually grow a tree that bears money.

The underlined statement has four reasons for its justification. Write the serial number of the reason you think correct:
We cook raw meat before consuming it because:-
options: (1) It changes the color to make it look more visually appealing on the plate.
(2) It kills harmful bacteria and parasites, making it safe and easier to digest.
(3) Cooking it adds artificial protein back into the muscle fibers.
(4) It makes the meat heavy enough to settle properly in the stomach.
questions.explanation: It kills harmful bacteria and parasites.

questions.question_text:
The underlined statement has four reasons for its justification. Write the serial number of the reason you think correct:
Vehicle tires have deep grooves and treads on them because:-
options: (1) They provide friction and grip to prevent the vehicle from skidding on roads.
(2) They make the wheels look stylish and aerodynamic for high speeds.
(3) They are designed to collect pebbles and clean the streets.
(4) The grooves reduce the overall weight of the rubber to save fuel.
questions.explanation: They provide friction and grip to prevent skidding.

questions.question_text: If 4 shirts cost 200 rupees, what is the cost of 6 shirts?
A man walks 10 meters North, turns right and walks 10 meters, then turns right again and walks 10 meters. In which direction is he now from his starting point?
questions.explanation: He faces North, turns right to East, turns right to South. He ends up 10 meters East of his start.

questions.question_text: Pointing to a boy, a man says, 'He is the son of my father's brother.' How is the boy related to the man?
questions.explanation: 'My father's brother' is his uncle. His uncle's son is his cousin.

questions.question_text: If the word 'CAT' is coded as 24, and 'DOG' is coded as 26, how is the word 'FOX' coded?
questions.explanation: Sum of alphabetical positions: F=6, O=15, X=24. 6+15+24 = 45.

questions.question_text: If the 3rd of a month falls on a Sunday, what day of the week will the 24th of the same month be?
questions.explanation: The difference is 21 days, exactly 3 weeks. The day remains the same: Sunday.
